enable_cpu_binding.previous_false: Explicit historical common change, not an upstream default; no necessity evidence found. All old False records retained and not reused as True qualification.

default_optimisation_audit.other_common_profile: MTP2/APC/async/FULL_AND_PIECEWISE, KV16GiB/rank, maxlen65536/seq16/batch4096/image1 remain exactly the predeclared shared profile. This is a configured actual base profile, not a claim about untouched upstream-default throughput.

zero_call_limit: The16GiB/seq16 profile has about1.08M token capacity and may not preempt in these tasks. Loaded/enabled/HTTP200 does not establish actual mechanism invocation or gains. Supplemental pressure diagnosis must be separately labelled and frozen.
quality: Original MMLU extractor and unchanged HLE/Frontier graders with independent gold answers; token mismatches are diagnostics, not proof of quality loss. SWE/Terminal have no solve score.
cost_and_initialisation: Keep10s host cgroup memory/stat/events/CPU and NPU sampling during init, raw load/compile logs, ready/process clocks, effective worker/thread affinity, warning/skip, actual owned child returncodes. Solver windows and judge traffic accounted separately.
reference_engine: Frozen Engine sources are only optional input/unchanged-grader references. No Engine r4/torch2.13 runtime replaces the tested MOD.
prior_cohort: Parent issued a preventive stop before completing the MOD document audit. Subsequent audit found the MOD off/on/runtime/workload design compatible; the user did not request cancellation.
